headline: Electronics Technician
summary: Electronics technician with three years repairing equipment in a rice mill and an ice plant in Capiz. I troubleshoot control panels and motor drives from wiring diagrams, measure and test circuits, and handle mechanical maintenance on the machines they control.
skills: Electronics repair: control boards, sensors, motor drives
Measurement with multimeters and clamp meters
Mechanical maintenance of motors and conveyors

experience.title: Electronics Technician
bullets: Repair control panels, sensors and variable-speed drives on milling and drying lines.
Trace faults from wiring diagrams and test circuits with multimeters and clamp meters.
Replace bearings, belts and couplings during planned maintenance stops.
Wire new motors and panels during a line upgrade with the plant electrician.

experience.title: Maintenance Helper
experience.employer: Roxas City Ice and Cold Storage
bullets: Assisted in repairing compressors and fans and cleaned condensers.
Operated the ice-making machines during night shifts.

certifications.name: Electronic Products Assembly and Servicing NC II
